g.text: I want to create a simulator
asks for selected map and scenario
asks for list of available maps
asks for list of available scenarios
asks for map and scenario selection
checks if map and scenario exists
checks for player budget in present map and scenario
creates new budget for selected map and scenario
gets the time period from the scenario
asks to execute the passage of time and generation of cargo
executes the passage of time and generation of cargo in parallel with the rest of the simulation
[if player picks an option from the game menu]
pauses both operations until action is over
displays the game menu and asks for player to select an option
executes the UI responsible for selected option
displays menu and asks for option again
